title: Nurture: Just starting out
note: Started by the AnyPress CRM plugin when someone who picked "Just starting out" on the contact form confirms they want email. Rename the answer on the contact form and this automation together.

emails.subject: Thanks for getting in touch
emails.preheader: Here is what to expect from us.
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name|there}},

You told us you are just starting out. A website is one of the best first steps, and with us it is ready in minutes, not weeks.

Over the next couple of weeks we will send you a few short emails with ideas that help. You can stop them at any time with the link at the bottom.

{{crm.business_name}}

Questions? Get in touch and a person will answer.

emails.subject: An example you might like
emails.preheader: How someone like you got started.
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name|there}},

Most new businesses we help start with a simple site: who they are, what they offer and how to get in touch. That is enough to look professional and start getting enquiries.

{{crm.business_name}}

Questions? Get in touch and a person will answer.

emails.subject: A short guide to your next step
emails.preheader: One thing to do this week.
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name|there}},

Write three sentences: what you do, who it is for, and how people reach you. That is the heart of your home page, and you can paste it straight in.

{{crm.business_name}}

Questions? Get in touch and a person will answer.

emails.subject: Can we help?
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name|there}},

If you would like to talk about what you need, we would be glad to help. Tell us a little about it and we will get back to you.

Get in touch

title: Welcome: Website
note: Started when a website plan starts (the contact gets "Website: Active"). "Your website is ready" comes separately, with the sign-in link.

emails.subject: Three things to do first on your website
emails.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name|there}},

Welcome. Your website is being set up and you will get its sign-in link in a separate email.

When you are in, do these three things first: put in your business name and logo, rewrite the home page in your own words, and add your contact details.

Go to my account

{{crm.business_name}}
